ALL THAT CERTAIN real property, situate, lying and being in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden, and State of New Jersey, the following described real property with the improvements and appurtenances thereunto belonging in fee simple, subject to the provisions of the Condominium Act of the State of New Jersey, N.J.S.A. 48:8B-1, et seq., its amendments and supplements and to the provisions of the Master Deed establishing and creating "The 89 Haddon Avenue Condominium", dated November 29, 1994, and to be subsequently recorded.
